entities.name: Vivien Reid
entities.description: A planeswalker and hunter who wields an arkbow and is living on New Capenna as an informant for an Obscura spy; she agrees to help Urabrask.

entities.name: Tezzeret
entities.description: A planeswalker largely encased in metal who ferries Phyrexian troops and praetors with the Planar Bridge for Elesh Norn while secretly playing both sides.

entities.name: Urabrask
entities.description: A wounded Phyrexian praetor hiding beneath New Capenna who refuses to submit to Elesh Norn and plans a challenge to her control.

entities.name: Elesh Norn
entities.description: The praetor who has come to dominate New Phyrexia and wants all life to become Phyrexian under her rule.

entities.name: Elspeth Tyrel
entities.description: A planeswalker laboring in New Capenna and joining the Maestros to learn the plane's history; sent by Ajani and feared by Elesh Norn.

entities.name: Navy
entities.description: An Obscura spy who trades information with Vivien in the Mezzio, but is secretly a double agent for the Adversary and tries to kill her.

entities.name: Anhelo
entities.description: A vampire of the Maestros who recruits Elspeth and takes her to the family's museum.

entities.name: The Adversary
entities.description: A planeswalker demon who holds real control over New Capenna's shadows and runs a lounge as a base of operations; this page does not name him.

entities.name: Ajani Goldmane
entities.description: A planeswalker of the Gatewatch who sent Elspeth to New Capenna.

entities.name: Kaya
entities.description: A planeswalker who fought a Phyrexian praetor on Kaldheim.

entities.name: Jin-Gitaxias
entities.description: A Phyrexian praetor who has pledged himself and his sphere to Elesh Norn.

entities.name: Vorinclex
entities.description: A Phyrexian praetor who has pledged himself and his sphere to Elesh Norn.

entities.name: New Capenna
entities.description: A plane dominated by a vertical industrial city with three levels (the Caldaia, the Mezzio and Park Heights), ruled by competing crime families and built atop the ruins of an older Capenna.

entities.name: New Phyrexia
entities.description: The Phyrexian regime led by the praetors, spreading through the Multiverse and seen as a virus by Vivien.

entities.name: Praetors
entities.description: The leaders of New Phyrexia, ferried across planes by Tezzeret.

entities.name: Black Thanes
entities.description: Phyrexian leaders, many of whom have pledged themselves and their spheres to Elesh Norn.

entities.name: Planar Bridge
entities.description: The glowing, plasma-like device within Tezzeret's chest that transports Phyrexians across planes and wounds them in transit.

entities.name: Halo
entities.description: A magic substance of New Capenna that grants wild power; Urabrask needs it to study.

entities.name: The Font
entities.description: A source of Halo guarded by the Cabaretti and moved regularly.

entities.name: Maestros
entities.description: A vampire crime family of New Capenna; Elspeth joins it and young members begin in its museum in Park Heights.

entities.name: Obscura
entities.description: A crime family of New Capenna claiming to rule the shadows and govern the city's secrets.

entities.name: Cabaretti
entities.description: A New Capenna family that guards the Font and supplies Halo.

entities.name: Gatewatch
entities.description: The group of planeswalkers Ajani represents and that Elspeth is gathering information for.

entities.name: Mezzio
entities.description: The middle level of New Capenna, all commotion and indulgence.

entities.name: Caldaia
entities.description: The lowest, industrial level of New Capenna, laden with haze and the thrum of industry.

entities.name: Park Heights
entities.description: The top level of New Capenna, of manicured nature and parks; home to the Maestros' museum.

entities.name: Quiet Furnace
entities.description: Urabrask's sphere of New Phyrexia, which he refuses to give to Elesh Norn.

entities.name: Angel's Breath
entities.description: A bar on the lower west side of New Capenna that was due a restock of Halo.

entities.name: The Crescendo
entities.description: An upcoming gathering in New Capenna that Maestros loyal to the Adversary plan to infiltrate and that Vivien expects to start the end of the city as it was.

entities.name: War of the Spark
entities.description: The war in which Vivien and Tezzeret fought on opposite sides.

events.summary: Vivien follows Tezzeret down through the girders beneath New Capenna, wary of him but trusting her gut.
events.quote: Vivien trusted her gut and followed him deeper into the underbelly of this strange, new plane.

events.summary: At the bottom of the city Vivien notices the ruins of the first Capenna, with claw marks gouged into the stone.
events.quote: These ruins must have been the first Capenna.

events.summary: Tezzeret reveals the glowing Planar Bridge in his chest as a show of trust, and admits it corrupted after carrying the praetors.
events.quote: "A show of trust and good faith."

events.summary: Tezzeret tells Vivien he works for Elesh Norn, and Vivien draws her bow on him in hostility.
events.quote: The bowstring was at her cheek in a breath, her opposite arm outstretched.

events.summary: Tezzeret admits he is playing both sides: he needs what Norn promised but does not want life destroyed or himself transformed, and Vivien relaxes.
events.quote: He was playing both sides.

events.summary: Tezzeret leads Vivien to a wounded Phyrexian, Urabrask, praetor of the Quiet Furnace, in a cavern below the city.
events.quote: "Vivien, meet Urabrask," Tezzeret said.

events.summary: Urabrask accuses Tezzeret of betraying him, and Tezzeret says he has brought a new ally.
events.quote: "You betrayed me," Urabrask hissed to Tezzeret.

events.summary: Urabrask explains he serves no one and will not give Elesh Norn the Quiet Furnace, and says he will lead a challenge to her control.
events.quote: "Yes. I will lead a necessary challenge to Norn's control."

events.summary: Vivien agrees to fetch Halo for the recovering Urabrask in exchange for his plan to bring Norn down, and learns the Planar Bridge wounded him.
events.quote: "You have a deal."

events.summary: Urabrask asks Vivien to find Elspeth, a planeswalker whom Norn fears.
events.quote: "Norn fears her. That is all I know."

events.summary: Vivien meets her Obscura contact Navy in the Mezzio, trading information about the Font and the Adversary's lounge while hiding what she knows.
events.quote: "Not yet, but I'll find out," Vivien lied.

events.summary: Navy gives Vivien a lead that a woman named Elspeth is taking odd jobs in the Mezzio.
events.quote: "Oh, I got a lead on your Elspeth character, however."

events.summary: Vivien sees a woman fight off Maestro enforcers in the street and then watches her give her name to the vampire Anhelo.
events.quote: The woman ignored the gesture, continuing to walk before she said, "Elspeth."

events.summary: Anhelo takes Elspeth to the Maestros' museum after she agrees to join the family.
events.quote: Anhelo had taken her right to the Maestros' museum after Elspeth had agreed to join the family

events.summary: Vivien goes to the Adversary's lounge hoping Elspeth will arrive as a Maestro, refuses to drink Halo, and sneaks some into a vial.
events.quote: Vivien could sneak some of the Halo out of the lounge and back to Urabrask without arousing suspicion.

events.summary: Vivien spots Navy slipping out the back and overhears her as a double agent arranging with a Maestro for the Crescendo.
events.quote: Navy was a double agent.

events.summary: Vivien hears a deep, vaguely familiar chuckle from a hidden room revealed in the lounge.
events.quote: She heard a deep chuckle echo from the back somewhere.

events.summary: Navy ambushes Vivien outside the lounge with a dagger, saying the boss does not like people sniffing near his doorstep.
events.quote: "And the boss doesn't like people sniffing this close to his doorstep."

events.summary: Vivien stabs Navy in the gut, tells her to seek the Obscura for help, and takes her notebook.
events.quote: with one hand she caught Navy by her forearm.

events.summary: Using the notebook's note, Vivien waits at a Halo drop-off point in a park for the Maestro collector.
events.quote: This was the drop off point for Halo, and the bag was waiting just as the memo said it would be.

events.summary: Vivien intercepts Elspeth at the drop-off and catches her wrist; Elspeth admits she is learning the plane's history and is there on Ajani's behalf.
events.quote: "Ajani sent me."

events.summary: Elspeth says New Capenna might be her home and that she wants to learn how its people beat a threat before.
events.quote: "It might be my home."

events.summary: Vivien declines to bring Elspeth to Urabrask yet, promising to share information when she has more, and leaves.
events.quote: "When I have something worthwhile."

events.summary: Vivien tells Urabrask she found Elspeth; Urabrask says she is the key and he will wait for her, her spark igniting his people and the Mirrans.
events.quote: "She is the key to our success."

events.summary: Vivien resolves to be at the Crescendo where Elspeth will likely be, and learns from Urabrask that the Adversary is a demon planeswalker.
events.quote: "Tezzeret mentioned he is a planeswalker, too."

relations.note: Works for New Phyrexia under Norn, though secretly playing both sides.
Refuses to serve Norn and plans to challenge her control.
relations.quote: But I serve no one, and those I lead wish to be left alone.

relations.note: Agrees to a deal to help him against Norn.
Considers Phyrexia the antithesis of everything she stands for.
relations.quote: Phyrexia was the antithesis to all she stood for

relations.note: Has pledged himself and his sphere to her.
relations.quote: Jin-Gitaxias, Vorinclex, and many of the Black Thanes have pledged themselves and their spheres to her grand vision.

relations.note: Introduced by Tezzeret as a praetor.
Revealed as a double agent working for the boss.
Attacks Vivien with a dagger on the boss's behalf.
relations.quote: She brought the dagger down toward Vivien's head.

relations.note: Stabs Navy in the gut but leaves her a chance to survive.
relations.quote: plunged it into the woman's gut.
